title: Creator-declared clothing colour regions
$comment: Only top/bottom/footwear material sections can opt in. The API additionally requires an approved creator-claimed linear data mask, unique IDs/channels per section, at most 8 logical region IDs per item, and coherent IDs/labels/default colours across internal garment variants. Reference luminance is measured from the authored albedo under the selected UV0 mask channel. This fixed colour remap retains albedo luminance detail, normal/surface textures and unmasked trim; it does not transport or reproduce arbitrary native material graphs. Empty wearer colours retain authored albedo exactly. A region with no luminance information needs explicitly authored neutral albedo/reference data before it can be offered. No mask-painting tool or scalar control is implied.
